title: Déjà Vu
overview: Taiki and Chinatsu's outing kicks off at a sports shop. But when an uninvited guest crashes their cafe plans, Taiki hears a name he won't soon forget.

title: Admiration
overview: After a tense run-in with Yumeka, Chinatsu opens up about their past on the train ride home. Taiki sets out to learn what tore apart their friendship.

title: They're One and the Same
overview: Yumeka snaps at Taiki for overstepping while a teammate's harsh words stir up old memories for Chinatsu. Later, a chance encounter catches her off guard.

title: Love Is the Most Powerful Feeling
overview: Chinatsu walks away, leaving Yumeka to confront her true feelings. Middle school memories come flooding back, revealing how her love for basketball faded.
